WITH orders_with_executions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.orderspivot, o.ordertune
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
), type_counts AS (
  SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders_with_executions
  GROUP BY ordertune
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordertune,
         order_count,
         CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.share > o.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The total count used for each type’s share is the number of distinct matched orders represented by executions; orders without executions are excluded. NULL ordertune values form one group.
